content: Matrix COMPLETE on R1b auto-installer: niri 115/115, niriWayle 118/118, kde 2026-11-05T23-06-01Z 78/78 (87 targets 55 covered + 32 installed 0 missing), cosmic 2026-11-06T00-40-31Z 78/78 (13 targets 6+7, playerctld via playerctl-user-dinit provide). kde fixes: system-config-printer-user-dinit provides (owner system-config-printer-common + bus), kmtpd5 unit into kio-user-dinit (fac7e34), kio-extras-user-dinit RETIRED (bcadb56). CI lesson x2 (runs 234/235 smoke fail): seed step loads REPODEST from PUBLISHED Pages -> retired apks linger and conflict; fix = prune vs expected set of pkgname+subpackages (4de453a); first attempt over-pruned live subpackages (polkit-common, cli11-dev, *-doc/-lang) caught by 42124526384. Installer NO-COMPILE (user decision): SetupDbusAudit runs the PACKAGED /usr/libexec/feralos/feralos-dbus-audit --no-fail (f33e8bd, nolint:nilerr skip-return); aports 0.1.0-r3 pinned f33e8bd (fff54cf) — aports = single source of truth, bump _commit pin on audit changes. Harness: timeout bump extended kde+cosmic (1f499ac, run 21-47-39Z voided verifyCtx), rehash ca-certificates warning allowlisted (778aa24).

CI seed hygiene rule: the aports seed step materializes REPODEST from the PUBLISHED Pages repo — a RETIRED package's apk lingers there and the smoke-install (installs every apk) conflicts with its successor. Every package retirement MUST come with a seed prune, and the expected-set must include EVERY subpackage entry (polkit-common, polkit-noelogind-libs, cli11-dev, *-doc/-lang/-openrc never have a src/<name> dir). Also: when the installer switches to a packaged binary (single source of truth), EVERY product change to that binary requires an aports pin bump in the same round or installs regress to the stale binary.
